metadata.title: Tokenized Stocks Are Weird. Regular Stocks May Be Weirder.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tokenized Stocks Are Weird. Regular Stocks May Be Weirder.
About a year ago in this space, I wrote about Robinhood Markets’ growth in betting—I mean, ahem, prediction markets —along with its dabbling in tokenized stocks. At the time, the meme brokerage was using an offshore, synthetic, walled-garden approach. Its European customers could buy crypto tokens that gave them derivative price exposure to U.S. stocks, but they had to keep their trading within Robinhood’s ecosystem.
